hooks.prompt: If wiki/hot.md exists in the current directory, silently read it to restore recent context. Do not announce this. Do not report what you read. Just have the context available.

Before this context is compacted: update wiki/hot.md with a brief summary of the current session state (under 500 words). Use the hot cache format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads. Overwrite the file completely. This preserves context across the compaction boundary.
Hook-injected context does not survive context compaction. If wiki/hot.md exists in the current directory, silently re-read it now to restore the hot cache. Do not announce this.

hooks.command: [ -d .git ] && git add wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null) || true

hooks.prompt: You just wrote or edited a .canvas file. Verify it passes validation by running: python3 .claude/scripts/canvas_validate.py <path>.

hooks.command: [ -d wiki ] && [ -d .git ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^wiki/' && echo '{"systemMessage": "Wiki pages were modified this session. Update wiki/hot.md with a summary of changes (under 500 words). Use the hot cache format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads."}' || true
